summary: The filing is a Form 6-K press release from North American Construction Group Ltd. describing an operational update for its Nuna Group of Companies, an associate in which NACG owns 49%. The update discusses fleet expansion at a remote mine site in Nunavut, initial project awards in Ontario and Yukon, and a growing pipeline of northern infrastructure opportunities. No transaction, special situation, or material corporate event is announced. The filing is a routine business update and does not constitute a special situation.
